correctness.rationale: The cyclic Fourier transform partitions monomial indices by residue class modulo m, and the value/derivative span in the degree-N sector is generated by sqrt(w_j),j sqrt(w_j). Its 2x2 positive Gram inverse gives the exact E=w_N/S[1+(N-mu)²/v]. A roots-of-unity Poisson filter controls conditional mean and variance uniformly when lambda/m² grows; a two-term lower bound on the Gram determinant suppresses all lambda<=m²(N/m²)^{1/4}=o(N). Differentiating H_N=e^{-lambda}lambda^N/N![1+(N-lambda)²/lambda] gives exact factor -(lambda-N)((lambda-N)²-N), independently symbolically verified. The two maxima N±sqrt N yield 2/sqrt(2πe) after Stirling. Independent conditional-Poisson numerical evaluations at (N,m)=(200,1),(300,3),(1000,10) show the expected bimodal profile, but do not establish the asymptotics without the uniform estimates.
